newsitem.title: USA: FERC dismisses Edison complaint against SoCal Gas.
newsitem.headline: FERC dismisses Edison complaint against SoCal Gas.

text.p: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) on Wednesday dismissed a complaint that Pacific Enterprises' Southern California Gas Co held too much power over interstate gas pipeline capacity.
The complaint was filed by Edison International's Southern California Edison Co.

SoCal Gas said in a statement Edison's allegations were "a ruse--a wild attempt to raise false issues to derail the proposed merger of Pacific Enterprises and Enova Corp and to eliminate any possible competition before electric industry restructuring is launched in California."
Edison filed its complaint in March at the FERC, but the commission said today there were no violations of FERC rules or orders.
